faq.description: The practical questions teams ask most, from how data connects to how rollout actually works.

questions.question: How is everything connected under the hood?
questions.answer: Every module reads and writes the same source of truth, so updating a compliance check or closing a finding shows up everywhere else instantly, with nothing to sync or re-enter by hand.

questions.question: Can we model our own risk register and controls?
questions.answer: Yes. Configure your own risk categories, KRIs, and control templates. Qiyrix doesn't force a fixed taxonomy on your organization.

questions.question: How does role-based access work?
questions.answer: Permissions are set per role, not per user. Change what a Light user, Lead Auditor, or Admin can do platform-wide, and it applies everywhere without reconfiguring each risk or site individually.

questions.question: Do you support multiple sites or entities?
questions.answer: Yes. Every site or business unit reports up automatically, so leadership isn't manually reconciling separate registers.

questions.question: Where does AI fit in?
questions.answer: AI suggests starting points, it doesn't make governance decisions. Templates, risk rankings, and recommended actions all route through your team for approval before anything becomes official record.

footer.description: A dedicated home for governance work, so a finding never gets stuck in someone's inbox or spreadsheet.

privacy.intro: Your privacy is our priority. This policy explains how we handle your data and the steps we take to keep it secure.

security.title: 1. Data Security & Storage
security.body1: We implement industry-standard AES-256 encryption for all data at rest and TLS/SSL for data in transit. Your inspection records and operational data are stored in secure, distributed cloud environments with 24/7 monitoring.
security.body2: Access to this data within our company is strictly limited to authorized personnel who require it to perform their jobs (e.g., technical support or database maintenance).

cookies.title: 2. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.body: We use essential cookies to keep you logged in and functional cookies to remember your preferences (like your preferred language or dashboard layout). We do not use tracking cookies for cross-site advertising.
